 PSG 2 – 0 Olympique Lyonnais Mayulu 72' Godts 84' FULL TIME Goals and Highlights: PSG 2-0 Lyon in Ligue 1 Match
 Watch PSG vs Lyon (Olympique Lyonnais) 2-0 goals, highlights, match stats and recap as Paris Saint-Germain beat Lyon in Ligue 1.
 Coverage by Victor Cunha Updated October 26, 2026, 5:30 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 5:30 PM ET 5:30 PM ET 42 minutes ago Thanks!
 And that's all for now! Thank you so much for watching this Ligue 1 match, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL! Stay tuned for updates and upcoming games. Good afternoon and see you next time!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 Key moments
 5:28 PM ET END OF MATCH 
 5:16 PM ET 85' Goal by Mika Godts · 2-0 
 5:11 PM ET 75' Yellow card 
 5:03 PM ET 70' Goal by Senny Mayulu · 1-0 
 4:45 PM ET 50' Yellow card 
 4:36 PM ET SECOND HALF STARTS 
 4:21 PM ET END OF FIRST HALF 
 4:10 PM ET 30' Yellow card 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 5:28 PM ET 44 minutes ago END OF MATCH
 In a first half with many chances created by both teams, the second half saw PSG creating danger and dominating the game to win 2-0, with goals from Senny Mayulu and Mika Godts, adding three more points in Ligue 1!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 90' 5:21 PM ET an hour ago Safonov
 Nartey received the pass up front and shot hard, but the defense blocked it. Shortly after, Remi Himbert came on for Tyler Morton, in another Lyon substitution. Nuamah received the pass up front and shot from distance, but it went straight into Safonov's hands.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 85' 5:16 PM ET an hour ago GOAL FOR PSG
 Ndjantou, with the long pass in front, found Mika Godts, who dominated, carried the ball and hit hard from the edge of the area, sending the ball into the left corner, into the back of the goal, increasing the score for PSG at the end of the game!
 PSG 2-0 Lyon | Mika Godts 84' https://t.co/cBpQ4HqpKp
— ⚽️@CenterOfGoals Follow (@Anthony81684960) October 26, 2026 Updates by Victor Cunha
 80' 5:14 PM ET an hour ago More changes
 Athekame received the pass up front and took a powerful long-range shot, but sent the ball wide. Following that, both teams made substitutions. For PSG, Akliouche and Doué were replaced by Ndjantou and Beraldo. For Lyon, Duranville was replaced by Boudache.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 ADVERTISEMENT
 75' 5:11 PM ET an hour ago Yellow and changes
 Khalis Merah received a yellow card for a foul on Vitinha. Shortly after, Lyon made two substitutions, with Khalis Merah and Tolisso leaving and Noah Nartey and Ruben Kluivert entering. Fabian Ruiz had a chance with a long-range shot, but sent the ball into Greif's hands.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 70' 5:03 PM ET an hour ago GOAL FOR PSG
 Mayulu received the pass on the left, took off and found the pass for Godts, who passed it back to Mayulu to take to the middle, hitting hard, low and into the right corner, sending the ball into the back of the goal, opening the score for PSG!
 MAYULU OPENS THE SCORE FOR PSG AGAINST LYON WITH AN INCREDIBLE GOAL😍😍😍#PSGOL https://t.co/dUFNsdXQFW
— Golazo Show (@GolazoShow1) October 26, 2026 Updates by Victor Cunha
 65' 5:01 PM ET an hour ago Changes in PSG
 Nuamah received the pass and found Niakhaté in the penalty area to get a shot off, but Safonov palmed the ball away! Shortly after, on the counter-attack, Ferran Torres received the pass and shot hard, but straight at the defense. And PSG made two substitutions, with Zaire-Emery and Ferran Torres leaving and Lucas Hernández and Mayulu entering.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 60' 4:56 PM ET an hour ago Change in PSG
 PSG made a change at that moment, with João Neves leaving and Mika Godts entering. Shortly after, Doué managed to pass to Ferran Torres, who took a powerful shot as soon as he entered the area, but it went straight into Greif's hands.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 55' 4:49 PM ET an hour ago Greif
 Doué received a pass from Fabian Ruiz and took a powerful shot, which deflected off the defense, earning a corner kick. The corner was taken into the box, but the defense cleared it. The play continued to Hakimi, who found Vitinha with a pass, but his long-range shot went straight into Greif's hands.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 50' 4:45 PM ET an hour ago Yellow card
 Maghnes Akliouche received a yellow card for a heavy foul on Moussa Niakhaté, who even had to be treated by doctors, already back in the game. Afterwards João Neves got the shot from the edge of the area, but it went out,
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:36 PM ET 2 hours ago SECOND HALF STARTS
 The players returned to the pitch at the Parc des Princes and the ball rolled for the second half of the match between PSG and Lyon, in the eighth round of Ligue 1, with all the action and excitement here on VAVEL!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 4:21 PM ET 2 hours ago END OF FIRST HALF
 And we go to halftime with the game tied at 0-0! PSG dominated the game, exchanging passes and creating dangerous chances. Despite this, Lyon also managed to create dangerous opportunities, even playing on the counter-attack, to end the first half at 0-0!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 45' 4:19 PM ET 2 hours ago Greif again!
 Vitinha delivered a through ball to Akliouche, who set up a powerful shot for Greif, whose effort was deflected for a corner. The ball was cleared away by the defense once again. PSG remain in the attacking third and continue to create chances.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 40' 4:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Greif - João Neves found the pass up front for Akliouche, who shot...
 João Neves found the pass up front for Akliouche, who shot powerfully from distance, but sent the ball into Greif's hands, who caught it without giving up a rebound. PSG dominates the game and manages to create dangerous chances in the attacking third.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 35' 4:13 PM ET 2 hours ago Safonov - Lyon continued their high pressure, and from another corner, the...
 Lyon continued their high pressure, and from another corner, the ball was cleared by the defense. Morton found Athekame with a pass, who shot from distance, but Safonov parried the ball away. Shortly after, Akliouche got a pass to Doué, who shot wide.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 30' 4:10 PM ET 2 hours ago Yellow card
 Vitinha received a yellow card for a hard foul on Nuamah. The free kick was taken and the play continued, with Nuamah finding Duranville in the box. Duranville got a shot off, but Safonov made the save, sending the ball over the goal for a corner. The corner was taken into the box and cleared by the defense.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 25' 4:04 PM ET 2 hours ago Greif - João Neves received the pass and found Ferran Torres in the box...
 João Neves received the pass and found Ferran Torres in the box for a powerful shot, but the ball went straight into Greif's hands. Shortly after, PSG won a corner, which was taken into the box and deflected by Fabian Ruiz, where Zabarnyi headed it towards goal, but the ball was blocked by the defense.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 20' 3:58 PM ET 2 hours ago Out - João Neves, on a cross into the area, managed to head the ball...
 João Neves, on a cross into the area, managed to head the ball towards Ferran Torres, who shot powerfully, but wide. PSG began to apply more and more pressure, starting to create chances once again in the attacking third.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 15' 3:54 PM ET 2 hours ago Overview of the game
 PSG manages to maintain possession in the attacking half, exchanging passes and trying to pick up the pace, while Lyon is compact in defense, preventing more shots on goal and creating dangerous opportunities at this point. Despite this, Lyon manages to break away on counter-attacks!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 10' 3:49 PM ET 2 hours ago Safonov - Fabian Ruiz received a pass from Hakimi and managed another...
 Fabian Ruiz received a pass from Hakimi and managed another powerful shot inside the box, but it went wide. Shortly after, Lyon responded with Morton finding Nuamah, who shot from distance, but it went straight into Safonov's hands.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 5' 3:47 PM ET 2 hours ago Greif - Zaire-Emery found the pass in front for Doué, who invaded the...
 Zaire-Emery found the pass in front for Doué, who invaded the area and shot hard, to the defense of Greif, who spread the ball away. PSG starts the match dominating and maintaining possession in the attacking field, trying to put pressure on Lyon.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:38 PM ET 3 hours ago HERE WE GO - The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Paris...
 The players took to the pitch and the ball rolled for the Paris Saint-Germain vs Lyon clash, in the first 45 minutes of this Matchday 8 of Ligue 1 match, with all the action and excitement of the duel here on VAVEL.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:23 PM ET 3 hours ago Lyon's bench
 For the game, Paulo Fonseca will have the following players available during the match against PSG: Remy Descamps, Ruben Kluivert, Noham Kamara, Clinton Mata, Noah Nartey, Mads Bidstrup, Adil Hamdani, Kail Boudache and Remi Himbert.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:22 PM ET 3 hours ago PSG's bench - For the game, Luis Enrique will have the following players...
 For the game, Luis Enrique will have the following players available during the match against Lyon: Lucas Chevalier, David Boly, Lucas Beraldo, Lucas Digne, Lucas Hernández, Senny Mayulu, Dro Fernández, Quentin Ndjantou and Mika Godts.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:19 PM ET 3 hours ago Lyon lined-up!
 With a 4-3-3 formation, Lyon is selected for the Liogue 1 match and will take to the field to face Paris Saint-Germain with: Freif, Athekame, Bacher, Niakhaté and Abner; Tessmann, Morton and Tolisson; Nuamah, Merah and Duranville.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:18 PM ET 3 hours ago PSG lined-up!
 With a 4-3-3 formation, Paris Saint-Germain's starting lineup for the League 1 match against Lyon is: Safonov, Hakimi, Zabarnyi, Pacho and Zaire-Emery; João Neves , Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz; Doué, Ferran Torres and Akliouche.
 Updates by Victor Cunha
 3:15 PM ET 3 hours ago Good afternoon!
 We're starting the broadcast of the match, with all the action and excitement of the duel between PSG and Lyon, in this eighth round of Ligue 1, with the ball rolling at the Parc des Princes, in this game between two teams from the top of the table!
 Updates by Victor Cunha
